lead: Glòries, the Torre Glòries and the 22@: the newest face of Poblenou.
text: Its name comes from the parks of the old Estació del Nord and the Ciutadella, although neither lies within the neighbourhood, and from La Llacuna, the road that linked Poblenou with El Clot. Its current boundaries date from 2006, and the area near the park used to be known as Fort Pius.

It is a neighbourhood of a more industrial and commercial character, where the 22@ district has brought new architecture such as the Torre Glòries, next to Plaça de les Glòries, with its metro and tram station and the Glòries shopping centre. It shares with Poblenou a nightlife area, La Marina, with venues such as Razzmatazz.
housing: New 22@ buildings and flats from different periods, next to former industrial warehouses.
